summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in own shares. On 28 May 2026, the company purchased 7,746,541 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 101.0764 pence per share, with a highest price of 101.70p and lowest of 100.25p. The purchases are part of an existing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026, with instructions issued on 29 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled. The filing corresponds to an issuer tender offer (open-market buyback). The programme reduces share count and returns capital to shareholders. Watch for ongoing buyback execution pace and cancellation effects on EPS.
